description: Complete the current stage. On a dispatch stage, also include selector with exactly one keyword the instruction lists. Do not call next on a bare tool acknowledgement — wait for the actual tool result first.

outcome.description: success or failure for this stage.

evidence.description: Brief reason grounded in the caller, tool result, or call event.

selector.description: Optional dispatch keyword. Use only when the stage instruction lists selector keywords.

success.description: true means the outcome was accepted; false means retry using next_instructions.

next_instructions.description: Guidance for what to say or do next.
